{{recipe}}

A tasty pie that doesn’t require baking.

== Ingredients ==

* 1 [[Cookbook:Pint|pint]] (570 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) [[Cookbook:cream|cream]]
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (60 ml) white granulated [[Cookbook:sugar|sugar]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. ready-made [[Cookbook:Pie Crust|pie crust]], [[Cookbook:Blind-baking|blind-baked]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Pound|pounds]] (900 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) fresh [[Cookbook:strawberry|strawberries]], cleaned and [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]]

== Procedure ==

# Combine sugar and cream in large mixing bowl, and [[Cookbook:Whipping|whip]] until soft and fluffy.
# Spread whipped cream in pie crust.
# Spread strawberries over whipped cream.
# Cover and chill overnight.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* Any remaining strawberries or cream can be stored for later use.
